description: Renovate is deliberately DISABLED on this repo. FooBarBaz-games/suno-api is a GitHub fork of gcui-art/suno-api, a third-party project this org does not maintain; its default branch main is unchanged since commit 7b7fd66 dated 2026-02-23. IMPORTANT NUANCE for anyone revisiting this: the repo is NOT unused — game-sdk documents it as the self-hosted Suno proxy for all game music (docs/suno-setup.md, consumed via SUNO_API_URL) and a Vercel Production deployment from 2026-02-23 still exists. What makes Renovate pointless here is that the Vercel Git integration no longer produces builds from this repo (zero deployments since 2026-03, and a 2026-09-06 branch push produced no deployment and no commit status), so dependency PRs merged here would never reach the running instance. The default branch also carries two conflicting lockfiles (package-lock.json and pnpm-lock.yaml) with no packageManager field, so Renovate would have to guess a package manager. To re-enable: confirm the deployment path is live again, resolve the lockfile conflict, then delete this file or set enabled to true.
